amendment.reason: The v1 audit showed that naive 5/95 clipping of log residual variances forced prior_df to the 1000000 boundary in several GSE71356 sensitivity analyses. Version 1.1 uses the standard un-winsorized log-variance method-of-moments estimator and retains ordinary OLS inference as an explicit diagnostic.

decision_basis: Outcome-blind metadata and technical-QC audit completed before differential-expression outcomes were read.
expression_unit: reviewed canonical UniProt accession after locked probe-gene-protein mapping

inference.method: ordinary least squares with limma-style empirical-Bayes residual-variance moderation
inference.variance_prior_estimation: standard un-winsorized log residual-variance method of moments
inference.unmoderated_diagnostics: retain ordinary OLS SE, t, two-sided P, and within-contrast BH-FDR beside moderated inference
inference.prior_boundary_rule: record prior_df_boundary; a boundary result is diagnostic-only and cannot create candidate-selection evidence
inference.missing_expression: protein-wise complete finite observations; fail a contrast if design rank or residual degrees of freedom is insufficient

GSE75097.technical_batch_rule: raw_array_label with the terminal position letter removed
GSE75097.bmi_rule: excluded because BMI is completely missing
GSE75097.hypertension_eds_rule: excluded from discovery models because they can be disease consequences or mediators

contrasts.estimand: one-level increase with PS=0, MSO=1, VSO=2
VSOC minus VSO; cross-sectional association, never called reversal

sensitivities: Repeat each eligible contrast with age_per_10y, female, and technical-batch fixed effects when the subset design is full rank.
Repeat OSA state, severe state, AHI, and ordinal models after restoring all 48 samples.
Sensitivity results cannot replace the registered primary estimate for candidate selection.

GSE71356.primary_sample_set: all 16 crossover assays from four participants
GSE71356.participant_sensitivity: exclude the complete four-assay block for subject #403
GSE71356.primary_design: intercept + subject fixed effects + IH + post_5h + IH:post_5h

detection_sensitivity.aggregation: rebuild gene and reviewed canonical UniProt matrices from the corresponding retained probe sets using the locked median-after-normalization rules

protein_context_evidence.unit: one reviewed canonical UniProt accession per row
